storia: Ukraine hits Kerch (Crimea) bridge in record 1,300+ drone attack; Russia says it intercepted them (AP, BBC, Bloomberg, Guardian). Russia also struck two major Kyiv bridges with ballistic missiles (BBC, DW)
angoli_fatti: While Russia hit two Kyiv bridges, Ukraine hit Russia's most symbolic bridge: a bridge-for-bridge duel, and who says what about the damage.
novita_oggi: Kerch bridge reportedly damaged while Russia hit Kyiv's bridges, causing power and water disruption; Moscow claims it downed 1,336 drones (some outlets cite 2,000+).
